workshoptitle: Project Inception: Enterprise AI Framework Companion LiveLab

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Explore the Inception framework, a realistic enterprise AI scenario, and the workshop outcomes.

tutorials.title: Get Started
tutorials.description: Sign in to the Oracle Cloud Console when your implementation exercise uses an OCI tenancy.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Frame an Enterprise AI Use Case
tutorials.description: Use a realistic scenario to identify users, decisions, data, controls, and a reference workflow.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Design the Inception Foundation
tutorials.description: Map the reusable runtime, agent patterns, data, identity, and observability components to your use case.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Explore MCP Servers and a Recipe
tutorials.description: Choose a governed tool boundary and trace Smart Dispatch as a reference workflow.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Apply Governance and Security
tutorials.description: Design identity propagation, tool exposure, data controls, guardrails, logging, and evaluation.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Consider Production Readiness
tutorials.description: Explore deployment, validation, operational, and release decisions for an enterprise AI solution.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Continue Your Inception Journey
tutorials.description: Select a next learning or implementation path and learn how to discuss approved implementation access.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Review common LiveLabs questions and support options.
